title: IT Security Engineer
description: Overview IT Security Engineer at Kyowa Kirin International plc Marlow – United kingdom WE PUSH THE BOUNDARIES OF MEDICINE. LEAPING FORWARD TO MAKE PEOPLE SMILE At Kyowa Kirin International (KKI), our purpose is to make people smile. This means more than drug discovery and development; it is about embedding care into everything we do to make a difference every day for those that need it most. We’re an inclusive pharmaceutical company that takes time to understand what really matters to our patients, their families, and their healthcare professionals, helping our people to take bold actions that deliver life-changing solutions sooner. Our culture is rooted in our values: Teamwork, Commitment to Life, Innovation, and Integrity. They help us to push boundaries to deliver extraordinary impact and make KKI a brilliant place to work. Job Purpose At Kyowa Kirin International, we're looking for a talented Security Engineer to help enhance and defend our enterprise network, data centre, and cloud environments. This is a hands-on role where you'll work alongside infrastructure and security teams to reduce cyber risk, improve resilience, and respond to evolving threats. Responsibilities Key Responsibilities: Design, implement and optimise security controls across network and cloud environments. Manage and improve firewall, IDS/IPS, and vulnerability management solutions. Identify security weaknesses and drive remediation activities. Support incident response and security investigations. Improve infrastructure logging, monitoring, and threat detection capabilities. Partner with global teams to strengthen security standards and best practices. Qualifications Position Requirements 3-5 years' experience in Security Engineering, Network Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering. Strong knowledge of firewalls, networking, IDS/IPS, and vulnerability management. Experience securing enterprise infrastructure and virtualised environments. Understanding of cyber attack techniques and defensive controls. Knowledge of Azure and/or AWS is desirable. Scripting or automation experience (PowerShell, Python, etc.) is a plus. A proactive problem-solver with a security-first mindset and strong collaboration skills. Why Join Kyowa Kirin? You'll be part of a highly collaborative global security team, working on meaningful initiatives that directly strengthen our cyber resilience. This role offers the opportunity to influence security strategy, drive continuous improvement, and make a real impact across the organisation. If you're passionate about cyber security and enjoy solving complex challenges, we'd love to hear from you. Salary range: between GBP £33,971.00/Yr. and GBP £50,956.00/Yr.
